name: columnCustomStatisticToMeetCriteria
displayName: Column Custom Statistic To Meet Criteria
description: This schema defines the test ColumnCustomStatisticToMeetCriteria. Test the specific custom statistic of a column to meet a given criteria based on an operator and threshold.

parameterDefinition.name: statisticType
parameterDefinition.description: The type of statistic to calculate (e.g., MAX, MIN, MEAN, MEDIAN, STDDEV, NULL_COUNT).

parameterDefinition.name: operator
parameterDefinition.description: The comparison operator (e.g., GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, EQUALS, GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUALS, LESS_THAN_OR_EQUALS, BETWEEN).

parameterDefinition.name: threshold1
parameterDefinition.description: The main threshold value to compare the statistic against. In case of BETWEEN operator, this is the lower bound.

parameterDefinition.name: threshold2
parameterDefinition.description: The upper bound threshold value. Only required if the operator is BETWEEN.
